column1: # Michigan circuit court judges as the One Court of Justice trial court directory listed them on 2026-11-25.
# Read once in Adam's Chrome (Claude in Chrome), no check page shown, through the directory page's own feed:
# All 83 counties fetched the way the page does, 0.6 s apart, every answer HTTP 200. Kept: the circuit court
# entries (courtCode C<nn>), merged across a circuit's counties and de-duplicated; the feed lists a judge once
# per court location, so a judge seated at three locations appears three times in the raw answer.
# A trailing * marks the feed's "Chief Judge" title; every other judge was titled "Circuit Judge".
